regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, keywords, and online-SI sentence
regions.finding: Verified the article title and aggregate palladium-catalyzed allene approach. The paper mentions online Supporting Information, but workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The cited A/B/C tricyclic product classes are prior work and are classified as literature examples; natural-product structures are context rather than reactions of this paper.

The Pd(OAc)2/Gorlos-Phos·HBF4/K2CO3/CH3CN 50 °C/7 h experiment is Table 1 entry 3. Its 3a/4a/5a NMR yields and 1a recovery are retained in that row; the ORTEP is characterization, not a second preparation.

regions.finding: The LB-Phos·HBF4 and Zheda-Phos·HBF4 failures map to Table 1 entries 1 and 2 and are not duplicated as narrative-only records.

unresolved: The printed online-SI statement does not establish an associated SI file in this workspace.

regions.finding: Three cited reaction classes were separated by their distinct allene functionality/conditions and classified as literature examples A, B, and C; they are not current-paper experiments.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 1 panel 2 current generic transformation
regions.finding: The generic 1+2a to 3 arrow with Pd(PPh3)2Cl2/K3PO4/CH3CN at 50 °C is a general scheme. Row-specific experiments are represented in Tables 1/2 and later schemes.
Tokinolide B, Diligustilide, Changxiongnolide B, and core D are biological/structural context; no reaction arrow or current preparation is reported.
Narrative yields map to Table 1 entries 3–10 and Table 2 entries 1–11. The 5 mmol Table 2 entry 3 remains a separate scale-up rather than being merged with entry 2.
The 1k/2a experiment gives (Z)-3k and (E)-3k in 51% combined yield with Z/E=2.3:1; the complete arrow on page 3 is linked to one two-product record.

unresolved: The 1k combined-yield basis and absolute scale are not stated.
Natural-product structures are contextual and were not converted into experiments.

regions.region: page 3 Table 1 reaction drawing, entries 1–10, and footnotes a–f
regions.finding: Ten independent optimization rows were retained with catalyst/ligand identities, shared charges, 50 °C, row times, three product-specific crude-NMR yields or dash markers, 1a recoveries, and footnote overrides. regions.region: page 3 Equation 1 arrow and product drawings
regions.finding: One nonsymmetric 1k experiment gives two tentatively NOE-assigned products, combined 51% yield and Z/E=2.3:1 under Pd(PPh3)2Cl2/K3PO4/CH3CN, 50 °C, 3 h.
The prose introduces two racemic 1l/1m runs and two enantiomeric (R)/(S)-1l runs, completed in Scheme 2 on page 5; each remains a separate experiment.

CH2-, NTs-, and sulfur-tether controls and the one-CN-replaced allene 2b control map to distinct Scheme 3 rows on page 5; no outcome was invented beyond complicated, dash/non-formation, or recovery values.

unresolved: Optimization header/footnote charge conflicts remain explicit rather than arithmetically repaired.
Failed-control detection limits and detailed workups are not reported.

regions.region: page 4 Table 2 reaction drawing, entries 1–11, and footnotes a–d
regions.finding: Eleven independent scope runs were retained with standard charges/conditions, row times, separate NMR and isolated yields, and a distinct 5 mmol scale-up. Entry 1 links to its detailed page-4/5 procedure.
The text confirms that the oxygen tether and both cyano groups are required; this supports the four failed/complicated control records and the merged Table 1 entry 10 oxygen-tether result.
IN-1 through IN-7 and paths a/b are a proposed catalytic mechanism leading to 3a or 4a; intermediates are not preparations.
Solvent drying, commercial-source, spectroscopy, TLC, and chromatography conventions are materials/analytical context, not independent reactions.

regions.region: page 4 beginning of detailed 3a Typical Procedure
regions.finding: Exact K3PO4/Pd(PPh3)2Cl2/1a/2a charges, split 3+7 mL CH3CN additions, nitrogen atmosphere, 50 °C/2 h, and TLC monitoring enrich Table 2 entry 1 rather than creating a duplicate.

unresolved: Most Table 2 rows lack detailed workup and product mass on pages 1–6.
Mechanistic intermediates are proposed and not independently observed.

regions.finding: Two separate reactions give 3l (2 h, 41%) and 3m (3 h, 38%); the prose states each racemic substrate affords one diastereomer exclusively.
Two distinct enantiomer runs give (1R,3R,7S)-3l (45%, 96% ee) and (1S,3S,7R)-3l (43%, >99% ee) at 50 °C for 2 h. Starting/product ee values are kept separately.

regions.region: page 5 Scheme 3 control table and arrow
regions.finding: The oxygen/2a row is merged with Table 1 entry 10. Separate CH2-tether, NTs-tether, sulfur-tether, and 2b controls retain 17/22/15.5/5.5 h, complicated or dash outcomes, and 71%/77% substrate recoveries where printed.

Table 2 entry 1 was completed with room-temperature cooling, ethyl acetate 10 mL×3 short-column workup, crude NMR 3a/4a/5a = 64/2/1%, image-confirmed mesitylene 46 uL, chromatography/recrystallization, 166.0 mg/51% 3a, and 138.1–138.6 °C melting point.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits absolute scale, 2a amount, solvent volume, detailed workup, and yield basis.
The page-text layer misreads 46 uL as mL; original image evidence was used.
